# Hirusha Suhan

> Hirusha Suhan (also known as Hiru) is a Sri Lankan full-stack developer and designer, and an undergraduate at Uva Wellassa University of Sri Lanka (Department of Computer Science and Informatics, specializing in Industrial Information Technology).

Canonical site: https://www.hirushasuhan.me

## Facts
- Name: Hirusha Suhan (alias: Hiru, Hirusha)
- Role: Full-stack developer, UI/UX and graphic designer
- Country: Sri Lanka
- University: Uva Wellassa University of Sri Lanka (UWU), Department of Computer Science and Informatics (CSI)
- Email: hirushasuhan@outlook.com

## Skills
- Languages: Java, Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, C / C++, PHP, SQL, Bash
- Web: Next.js, React, Tailwind CSS, HTML5/CSS3, REST APIs, Three.js / WebGL, Framer Motion
- Data and systems: MySQL, relational modeling, Linux (Ubuntu), Windows Server
- Networking and DevOps: IPv6 and routing (APNIC Academy), Git and GitHub, CI/CD, Docker
- Design: UI/UX, Figma, Canva, posters and event branding
- Certifications: Pearson Diplomas in IT and English, APNIC Academy (IPv6 & Routing), HackerRank (Java, Python, JavaScript), University of Moratuwa (Web Design, Python)

## Projects
- [Serandib Grand](https://github.com/hirushasuhan/serandib_grand): hotel reservation system with role-based access (PHP, MySQL). Demo: https://serandib-grand.wasmer.app
- [UniAlloc](https://github.com/hirushasuhan/UniAlloc_host): university resource and workload system (Next.js, TypeScript, MySQL). Demo: https://www.unialloc.app/login
- [Visa Consultation Platform](https://github.com/hirushasuhan/web-project-Visa-consultation-Company): appointment scheduling and eligibility checkers (HTML, CSS, JavaScript)
- [Bus Fleet Management System](https://github.com/hirushasuhan/bus-management-system): Java and MySQL fleet management with scheduling logic
- [Financial Expense Tracker](https://github.com/hirushasuhan/Expense-_Tracker): Java desktop personal-finance application
- [Console Banking System](https://github.com/hirushasuhan/Banking-system-C): banking workflows with file persistence, written in C
- [Bulk Mail & QR Ticket Generator](https://github.com/hirushasuhan/bulk-mail-and-auto-qr-and-ticket-generate-system): personalized QR tickets and bulk email (JavaScript)
